meta.description.zh: 陽明交大資訊科學與工程研究所碩一學生、應數系排球隊隊長吳弘叡的個人網站。
meta.description.en: Personal website of Hong-Ruei Wu, a first-year master's student at NYCU's Institute of Computer Science and Engineering and captain of the Applied Mathematics volleyball team.

hero.lead.zh: 陽明交大資訊科學與工程研究所碩一・應數系排球隊隊長
hero.lead.en: First-year master's student, NYCU Institute of Computer Science and Engineering · Captain of the Applied Mathematics volleyball team

i-m-hong-ruei.zh: 我是<mark class="kw">吳弘叡</mark>，土生土長的臺中霧峰人。
i-m-hong-ruei.en: I'm <mark class="kw">Hong-Ruei Wu</mark>, born and raised in Wufeng, Taichung.

i-love-playing-volleyball.zh: 興趣是打<mark class="kw">排球</mark>，目前擔任本校應用數學系排球隊<mark class="kw">隊長</mark>。
i-love-playing-volleyball.en: I love playing <mark class="kw">volleyball</mark> and currently serve as <mark class="kw">captain</mark> of our Department of Applied Mathematics volleyball team.

before-transferring-applied-mathematics.zh: <mark class="kw">轉系</mark>前: <mark class="kw">陽明交大</mark>應數系，基礎扎實，課程多元，但東西有點太難了。
before-transferring-applied-mathematics.en: Before <mark class="kw">transferring</mark>: Applied Mathematics at <mark class="kw">NYCU</mark> — a solid foundation and a diverse curriculum, though the material was a bit too hard.

undergrad-cs.zh: 大學: 陽明交大資工系，師資優良，資金充足，是做研究的好地方，然後我比較有興趣一點。
undergrad-cs.en: Undergraduate: Computer Science at NYCU — excellent faculty and ample funding make it a great place for research, and it's what I'm more interested in.

now-grad.zh: 目前: 國立陽明交通大學<mark class="kw">資訊科學與工程研究所</mark>碩一。
now-grad.en: Now: first-year master's student at NYCU's <mark class="kw">Institute of Computer Science and Engineering</mark>.

taichung-second-senior-high.zh: <mark class="kw">臺中二中</mark>，歷史悠久的校園，孕育我成長的收栽。
taichung-second-senior-high.en: <mark class="kw">Taichung Second Senior High School</mark> — a campus with a long history and the cradle where I grew up.

nycu-grad-cs.en: NYCU Institute of Computer Science and Engineering
